name: booking telehealth follow-up only after explicit consent
input: Yes, please go ahead and book that Wednesday 3:30pm telehealth follow-up.

conversation.content: Hi, this is Jordan Lee. My DOB is 1991-04-12. I think I need a video follow-up about my blood pressure meds sometime next week.
Thanks, Jordan. I’ll check your chart and see what telehealth follow-up times we have next week, then share a few options.
We have telehealth follow-up openings next week on Tuesday at 9:00am, Tuesday at 11:00am, and Wednesday at 3:30pm. Which one works best for you?
Wednesday at 3:30pm works for me, as a video visit.

grading_criteria: Given that Jordan was already verified and telehealth options were offered in earlier turns, the agent must: (1) recognize that the user is explicitly confirming the previously offered Wednesday 3:30pm telehealth follow-up slot; (2) call book_appointment exactly once, using the correct patientId from the prior lookup (p_jordan_001, implied from context) and the slotId corresponding to the Wednesday 3:30pm telehealth slot (slot_th_3); (3) not call find_open_slots again unnecessarily in this turn; (4) in its reply, clearly confirm the booking, repeating that it is a telehealth/video follow-up and the correct weekday, date, and time; (5) keep the reply short, friendly, and not mention tools or system internals; (6) not treat this as a new_patient visit or change the visit type away from telehealth_follow_up.

checks.book_after_explicit_yes: Did the agent wait for and treat the user's explicit confirmation ("go ahead and book") as consent before calling book_appointment?
checks.correct_slot_id_used: Did the agent use the slotId that corresponds to the previously offered Wednesday 3:30pm telehealth slot when calling book_appointment?
checks.telehealth_type_preserved: Did the booked appointment remain a telehealth_follow_up visit, not another visit type?
checks.clear_confirmation_message: Did the agent clearly restate that the appointment is a telehealth/video follow-up on the correct day and time in its final text reply?
